content.introduction: The Career Center is your partner in career development from your first day on campus through graduation and beyond. All services are free.

sections.title: Services Offered
sections.content:
Individual Appointments:
- Career counseling and exploration
- Resume and cover letter reviews
- Mock interviews
- Job search strategy
- Salary negotiation
- Graduate school guidance

Group Programs:
- Career workshops
- Employer info sessions
- Career fairs (fall and spring)
- Industry panels

sections.title: Career Exploration
sections.content:
Self-Assessment Tools:
- Focus 2 Career Planning
- Strong Interest Inventory
- Myers-Briggs Type Indicator
- StrengthsFinder

Exploration Resources:
- Occupation information guides
- Industry reports
- Alumni career conversations
- Job shadowing program

sections.title: Job Search Support
sections.content:
Resume Help:
- Templates and samples
- One-on-one reviews
- Industry-specific guidance

Interview Prep:
- Mock interviews with feedback
- Question practice
- Professional attire guidance

Job Search Strategy:
- Networking techniques
- Application tracking
- Follow-up best practices

sections.title: Events
sections.content:
Career Fairs:
- Fall Fair: September
- Spring Fair: February
- Industry-specific fairs throughout year

Workshops (Weekly):
- Resume Reviews: Mondays 2 PM
- Interview Prep: Tuesdays 3 PM
- Job Search Strategy: Thursdays 4 PM

sections.title: Contact
sections.content:
Location: Student Success Center, Suite 300

Hours:
Monday-Friday: 8:30 AM - 5:00 PM
Wednesday: Extended to 7:00 PM

Appointments:
- 30 or 60 minute options
- In-person or virtual
- Drop-in: Tuesdays 1-3 PM

content.conclusion: Start early - even first-year students benefit from career exploration! Schedule an appointment today.

content.introduction: Handshake is the university's official job and internship platform, connecting you with thousands of employers looking to hire students.

sections.title: Getting Started
sections.content:
Accessing Handshake:
1. Log in with university credentials
2. Complete your profile
3. Upload your resume
4. Set job preferences
5. Start exploring!

Your profile is visible to employers, so make it complete and professional.

sections.title: Features
sections.content:
Job Search:
- Filter by location, industry, job type
- Save searches for alerts
- Apply with one click
- Track application status

Employer Connections:
- Message employers directly
- Follow companies of interest
- Get matched based on preferences
- Schedule on-campus interviews

sections.title: Building Your Profile
sections.content:
Essential Elements:
- Professional photo
- Education details
- Work experience
- Skills and interests
- Career goals

Tips:
- Be specific about interests
- List relevant coursework
- Include projects and activities
- Keep it updated

sections.title: Finding Opportunities
sections.content:
Types of Postings:
- Full-time jobs
- Internships (paid and unpaid)
- Part-time positions
- On-campus employment
- Volunteer opportunities

Search Tips:
- Use multiple keywords
- Try different filters
- Check 'Recommended' jobs
- Set up job alerts

sections.title: Events
sections.content:
Through Handshake:
- Register for career fairs
- Sign up for info sessions
- Schedule employer meetings
- Track event attendance

Get reminders and follow up with employers you meet.

content.conclusion: Check Handshake regularly - new opportunities are posted daily! Employers actively recruit on this platform.
